svg.title: Au–MoS₂–Au top-contact device: actual near-edge vacancy geometry
svg.desc: True Cartesian x–z side view of all 316 source atoms in the F0 Au top-contact calculation, viewed along y. Au is gold, Mo blue, S teal. Two hollow red circles mark the absent top-layer S atoms verified against the pristine P calculation. The same scale is used along x and z. No atoms are replicated and no bonds are inferred.

g.text: Au–MoS₂–Au top contact · near-edge vacancies marked
